collection.title: BMW 3 Series Touring 2009 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 3 Series Touring 2009 to 2012 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this 3 Series Touring which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
